name: Possibility State Weave
candidate_class: physical/runtime representation for unresolved epistemic alternatives
primary_claim_tested: shared base+sparse divergence+exact pure read-signature lifting can reduce alternative-state cost without epistemic merge or authority promotion
strongest_positive_result: large low-divergence state/compute sharing region exists and a simple adaptive representation policy can track crossover closely in synthetic tests
strongest_negative_result: PSW and conventional overlay memo have identical pure evaluation group counts; PSW adds metadata and no distinct algorithmic benefit in measured proxy
hard_safety_result: incomplete material read set makes cross-branch computation reuse unsound
